## Exact failing version and evidence
[PR #206](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-linear/pull/206), head `0ad48b35d55743608dde2a9d92eddc4be8f06508`, upgrades the development SDK from 2026.10.28 to 2026.11.1 (and changelog/ops pins). Hosted tests execute merge `88c02e7a2286dbc3d1f27ed531770dfdc6c25908` against base `033b0601597aebd27c627d85bbcfad138beaf6d1`.

Both [Node 22](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-linear/actions/runs/41865301849/job/126697903105) and [Node 26](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-linear/actions/runs/41865301849/job/126697902917) finish with **457 tests, 352 passed, 105 failed**. Numerous creation/import/ownership tests report:

`--parent must not use placeholder token "none". Use --unset parent to clear this field.`

The npm and Bun release gates also fail on that head. The 105 total failures are not all individually attributed to this one cause.

## Producer and source goal
The [forward importer](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-linear/blob/0ad48b35d55743608dde2a9d92eddc4be8f06508/index.ts#L2904-L2943) unconditionally sets `values.parent = "none"` when the target does not exist, then passes those values to `pm.create`. The [shared create-plan producer](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-linear/blob/0ad48b35d55743608dde2a9d92eddc4be8f06508/index.ts#L3398-L3411) likewise emits `parent: "none"`. These are package-generated controls, not invalid provider values.

The [canonical field-ownership record](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-linear/blob/0ad48b35d55743608dde2a9d92eddc4be8f06508/.agents/pm/features/pm-linear-field-ownership.toon) explicitly records the intended invariant: both creation paths clear ambient parent/scope defaults. Preserve that invariant using the installed SDK's supported typed mutation contract. Simply omitting the field may reintroduce ambient-focus inheritance.

Expected: ordinary valid imports and isolated ownership projections can create unparented items while clearing ambient scopes. Actual on the upgraded SDK: the package's own placeholder is rejected. This blocks SDK compatibility acceptance and ordinary new-item import paths under the tested version; it is not evidence of a live Linear incident or data loss.

## Existing ownership and limits
All 206 all-status issue/PR records, PR206 discussion/reviews, and 117 canonical task/issue/feature/chore records were inspected. Open #188 covers different missing-configuration read failures. The existing `pm-linear-literal-sdk-values` item tracks literal provider fields and upstream #1614, not these package-generated parent controls. Core [#1655](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/issues/1655)/[#1658](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/pull/1658) address typed parent clearing and diagnostics upstream; that does not automatically migrate Linear's producers or establish behavior on the pinned 2026.11.1 artifact.

Evidence is exact immutable source plus completed hosted execution. No local full suite, provider API calls, production data changes, publication check, or proof that every failing test has the same cause is claimed.

## Acceptance and regression criteria
- Migrate every package-generated parent-clear producer to a supported contract on the accepted SDK version, or hold/refuse the incompatible upgrade with an explicit actionable explanation. Do not weaken SDK placeholder validation or use private SDK internals.
- Cover both forward new-item creation and shared create-plan/ownership projection with actual SDK readback, including ambient parent and goal/objective/sprint/release defaults. Assert created items remain unparented and unintended scopes are absent.
- Retain existing-item relationship preservation, literal provider-value guards, typed refusal behavior, source-copy isolation, forward-only receipts, and no unsafe rollback.
- Rerun focused creation/ownership regressions, complete Node22/26 and npm/Bun release gates, and packed-consumer acceptance on the selected supported SDK. Report unrelated failures separately, preserving coverage thresholds and assertions.
